content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: IBPS will conduct the CRP RRBs-XV recruitment process for Office Assistant and Officer posts in Regional Rural Banks. The post-wise positions covered under the recruitment are given below. The detailed post-wise vacancy numbers should be checked after the detailed notification is released by IBPS.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required educational qualification for the post they wish to apply for. Post-wise eligibility details are given below: Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised University or its equivalent. Candidates should have proficiency in the prescribed local language of the participating RRB. Working knowledge of computers is desirable. Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager): Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised University or its equivalent. Preference may be given to candidates having degrees in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing & Cooperation, Information Technology, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy. Local language proficiency and computer knowledge are also applicable. Officer Scale-II General Banking Officer (Manager): Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate along with the prescribed banking or financial institution experience. Officer Scale-II Specialist Officer (Manager): Candidates must possess the relevant qualification for the concerned specialization such as Information Technology, Chartered Accountancy, Law, Treasury, Marketing or Agriculture along with the prescribed experience. Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager): Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and minimum five years' experience as an Officer in a Bank or Financial Institution.

content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Office Assistant (Multipurpose): 18 to 28 years Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager): Above 18 years and below 30 years Officer Scale-II (Manager): Above 21 years and below 32 years Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager): Above 21 years and below 40 years Age relaxation for reserved-category candidates will be applicable as per the rules mentioned in the detailed IBPS CRP RRBs-XV notification. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Preliminary Examination followed by Main Examination. There is no interview for the Office Assistant post. Officer Scale-I: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Interview. Officer Scale-II & III: Single Online Examination followed by Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in. Open the CRP RRBs section on the homepage. Click on the CRP RRBs-XV recruitment link. Select the appropriate application link for Officers or Office Assistants. Click on the New Registration option. Complete the registration using the required personal and contact details. Fill out the online application form carefully. Upload the required photograph, signature and other prescribed documents. Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges through online mode. Check all the entered details before final submission. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 is the Common Recruitment Process (CRP RRBs-XV) conducted by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection for recruitment of Office Assistant (Multipurpose) and Officer Scale-I, II and III posts in Regional Rural Banks.

faq.question: Q2. When will IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 will start on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the application fee/intimation charges is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which posts are available under IBPS RRB CRP XV 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Office Assistant (Multipurpose), Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager), Officer Scale-II (Manager) and Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates generally need a Bachelor's Degree or relevant professional qualification depending on the post. Officer Scale-II and III posts also require prescribed qualifications and work experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by post. It is 18 to 28 years for Office Assistant, above 18 and below 30 years for Officer Scale-I, above 21 and below 32 years for Officer Scale-II, and above 21 and below 40 years for Officer Scale-III. Applicable age relaxation will be provided as per IBPS rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Office Assistant candidates will undergo Preliminary and Main examinations. Officer Scale-I candidates will have Preliminary, Main and Interview stages, while Officer Scale-II and III candidates will appear for a Single Online Examination followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When will the IBPS RRB 2026 exams be conducted?
faq.answer: Officer Scale-I Preliminary Exam is scheduled for 21 and 22 November 2026. Office Assistant Preliminary Exam will be held on 06, 12 and 13 December 2026. The Officer Scale-I Main and Officer Scale-II/III Single Exam are scheduled for 20 December 2026, while the Office Assistant Main Exam is scheduled for 30 January 2027.
